verdict.rationale: Evidence only mentions Apps Script as a low-code way to automate Admin console tasks, which could technically support event-driven scripts, but there is no explicit documentation of a rules engine or event-trigger framework for general Workspace actions (e.g., email/event-based automation) that a user could define declaratively. Missing for 10: explicit rule/trigger definition UI, examples of event-based automations, and AI-native support for auto-generating such rules.
